$comment: The Tier-0 inventory (configuration-and-reference-data.md §2.1), machine-readable. Every `enum` in every schema under this directory must be listed here with the reason CODE BRANCHES ON IT — that is what makes it a contract enum rather than a list an operator should manage (Tier 1 registry, Tier 2 vocabulary). `npm run tier0:check` fails on an enum that is not here, on an entry whose enum is gone, and on the same value set defined twice (a Tier-0 enum has ONE definition: a $def in common.schema.json). Keyed by file and JSON pointer.
common.schema.json#/$defs/Tier: HSM's placement and restore logic switch on it.
common.schema.json#/$defs/RenditionKind: MTS produces each kind; Studio picks a player or viewer per kind.
common.schema.json#/$defs/Severity: Notifications, tasks and alerts route and render by severity.
common.schema.json#/$defs/TaskKind: Each kind is a distinct task UI and completion rule; BMS declares it, emits it, Notifications re-emits it.
common.schema.json#/$defs/PrincipalKind: Assignment and addressing resolve a user directly and a group through membership — two code paths.
common.schema.json#/$defs/UserState: IAM's account state machine: lockout, invitation and disabling are coded transitions.
common.schema.json#/$defs/SettingScope: The nearest-wins resolver walks these levels in a fixed order.
common.schema.json#/$defs/AiTier: Online and offline enrichment are different execution paths with different latency budgets.
common.schema.json#/$defs/AiTask: Each task is its own model pipeline in the AI service.
common.schema.json#/$defs/PublishKind: Each kind is its own outbound connector implementation; the TARGETS are a Tier-1 registry.
envelope.schema.json#/properties/actor/p: Discriminates a service actor from a user actor for audit and authorization.
file.schema.json#/properties/storage/pro: Gates whether a file may be exported to air.
file.schema.json#/properties/provenance/: Discriminated union in the file contract; each producer attaches different provenance.
policy-rule.schema.json#/properties/effe: The evaluator's decision algebra: deny overrides and short-circuits.
setting-descriptor.schema.json#/properti: The admin-UI form renderer and the value validator switch on it.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/propert: Workflow-definition state machine: only published definitions can be instantiated.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/$defs/R: Fixed and exponential are distinct delay computations in the engine.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/$defs/V: The variable validator and the expression evaluator switch on the declared type.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/$defs/S: The interpreter has one executor per node kind.
Fail and compensate are distinct code paths in the engine's error handling.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/$defs/H: Reassign and notify are distinct escalation behaviours.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/$defs/T: Duration, date and cron are three different scheduling computations.
workflow-definition.schema.json#/$defs/P: Split and join are the two halves of the parallel gateway; the engine treats them differently.
events/ai.suggestion.raised.payload.sche: Each suggestion kind lands in a different Studio affordance (person, tag, subject, caption).
events/asset.deleted.payload.schema.json: Deletion reason is a discriminated union: retention, manual and policy deletions are audited and reversible differently.
events/asset.expired.payload.schema.json: Whether expiry came from the asset or was inherited from its category decides what an operator can override.
events/asset.updated.payload.schema.json: User, AI and technical provenance of a change are ranked differently when they conflict.
events/config.changed.payload.schema.jso: The tier system itself: registry, vocabulary and setting changes invalidate different caches.
events/editor.render.requested.payload.s: Video, audio and photo renders are different pipelines.
Added and removed are the two directions the permission recompute handles.
events/ingest.detected.payload.schema.js: Each source kind is a distinct ingest mechanism; the SOURCES (a folder, a recorder) are a Tier-1 registry.
events/schedule.updated.payload.schema.j: Schedule state machine with coded transitions; send-to-air is gated on it.
events/schedule.validated.payload.schema: Each issue kind is a validator with its own rule.
events/story.updated.payload.schema.json: Newsroom story state machine with coded transitions.
events/task.updated.payload.schema.json#: Task lifecycle state machine; forwarded and cancelled have distinct notification behaviour.
events/taxonomy.updated.payload.schema.j: The SET of vocabularies is code — each has its own table, index and UI. The TERMS are Tier 2.
Each action drives a different search-index and cache update; merge and deprecate are not deletes.
events/workflow.completed.payload.schema: Completed, failed, cancelled and compensated end a workflow instance through different paths.
events/workflow.step.requested.payload.s: The step executor is chosen by kind.
